name: Death Caps
source:
I know this is going to be a bad trip, but it doesn't feel like it...

Death Caps,  a short 18+ visual novel about self acceptance and drug trips.

[from [url=https://yonkbonkers.itch.io/death-caps]itch.io[/url]]

我知道，这会是一场糟糕的致幻体验，可感觉并非如此…

《Death Caps》，一部关于自我接纳与药物致幻体验的18禁短篇视觉小说。
